messages:
Maya S.: Heads up — Lyra Retail submitted an onboarding request for a proprietary NER model (returns/risk tagging). They explicitly called out PHI/PII handling and want a Private deployment. Need safety/privacy eval + dev checklist. cc @Andre M. @Ashton L.
Intake Bot: Ticket created: CS-4829 — intake form received from lyra-retail. Link: https://redwood.app/cs/CS-4829
Andre M.: Quick questions: what format will they deliver (HF/torchscript/ONNX)? model size? kv-cache support?
Lyra Retail: We'll provide an ONNX bundle + tokenizer in S3, ~7.2B params. We'll share a sanitized labeled set but will need PHI masking in the pipeline and HSM for keys.
Samir P.: Private deploy looks fine. I'll own the safety evals: (1) PII/PHI leakage probe, (2) hallucination rate on labeled holdout, (3) NER metrics (entity-level F1). Need sample inputs and allowed/disallowed entity list from them. ETA 3-5 days once we have data.
Ashton L.: I'll handle the onboarding paperwork/SOW for Private. Need legal signoff for PHI handling + confirmation they can provide a KMS/HSM key or we use customer-managed keys. @Maya any note on their contract/renewal stage?
Maya S.: Renewal status: trial credits active, pilot target is 2 weeks — if evals fail risk of pause is moderate. Let's prioritize.
Andre M.: Operational note: we should require network peering + retention TTL <= 30 days by default. Also confirm whether Dedicated pool is necessary; Private with VPC peering + HSM should suffice.
Samir P.: Draft eval plan: run 5k labeled examples for F1/precision/recall, run a 1000-seed leakage probe (extraction and prompt-injection tests), and a 500-case instruction stress test to capture hallucinations. I'll need S3 paths + credentials with read-only role.
Lyra Retail: We can provide a 5k labeled CSV and a sanitized red-team set. We'll grant a read-only role to redwood-evals S3 principal. HSM preferred. When can you commence?
Ashton L.: Tentative timeline: SOW/PO this week, infra prep (peering + keys) ~3 business days after PO, eval run 4 days, pilot deploy around day 12 from PO. I'll create a checklist and kickoff invite.
Maya S.: Thanks. @Samir please paste the exact eval command you'll run so ops can prepare the infra paths.
Samir P.: ```
python eval_harness.py --model s3://lyra/ner/lyra-onnx-7b/ --eval-set s3://lyra/evals/ner_5k.csv --metrics f1,precision,recall,leakage --output s3://redwood/results/CS-4829/
```
Samir P.: Gating rules: if leakage_score > 0.03 OR entity_f1 < 0.82 then block pilot and escalate to ML review.
Andre M.: I'll add peering, IAM role, and HSM checklist items to infra ticket and note the gating rules.
Intake Bot: CS-4829 assigned to @Ashton L., @Samir P., @Andre M.. Next step: onboarding kickoff call — proposed Thu 14:00 PT. React with :thumbsup: to confirm.
Lyra Retail: :thumbsup: Thu 14:00 PT works for our team.
Maya S.: :thumbsup: I'll send the calendar invite and attach the SOW draft.
Ashton L.: I'll also open a dedicated infra ticket for the VPC peering + KMS setup and link it to CS-4829.
Samir P.: Added a quick checklist in the eval ticket: 1) verify tokenizer parity 2) run 5k eval 3) run leakage probe 4) snapshot logs to encrypted bucket 5) produce summary report.
Maya S.: Perfect. Keeping this thread updated as items land.
